name: Glanbrücken (Germany)
description: Quartered yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Glanbrücken (a bridge, a wavy bend, a crescent and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Glanbrücken; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Glanbrücken arms — bridge, wavy bend, crescent and lion
